name: Kuo, S.A.B. de C.V.
summary: Kuo, S.A.B. de C.V., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sale of processed food and drinks, plastics and chemical products, and transmissions and auto parts in Mexico, the United States, Spain, Belgium, and China. The company operates through Consumer, Industrial, and Consumer segments. It is also involved in breeding and development of pig farming; marketing of pork; manufacturing of polystyrene and synthetic rubber; and provision of transmission manuals and manuals. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Mexico City, Mexico.
